title: LINE
description: Let customers chat with Agents through your LINE Official Account. Chats enter the queue you choose and are routed by the same Router as Voice and Web Chat.
firstTime: LINE is not set up yet. Enter the details from LINE Developers, choose a queue and save. Default: a chat closes after {{minutes}} minutes without a customer reply.
readOnly: You can view these settings only. Only an Admin can change them.

forbidden.title: This account cannot view the LINE settings
forbidden.body: This page is for the tenant's Admins and Supervisors. Contact your organization's Admin to change the settings.

locked.title: LINE is not enabled in this system
locked.body: Contact the platform administrator to turn it on.

loadFailed: Could not load the LINE settings
unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

routing.title: Receiving chats
routing.sub: Applies to new chats. A chat already open keeps its settings until it ends.
routing.queueHint: Agents in this queue who are Ready receive the chats
routing.idle: Close a chat after customer silence (minutes)
routing.idleHint: {{min}}–{{max}} minutes, counted from the Agent's last message the customer has not answered

connection.title: Connection to LINE
connection.sub: Details from LINE Developers for your Messaging API channel. The channel secret and access token are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
connection.secretHint: 32 characters (0–9, a–f), on the Basic settings tab
connection.tokenHint: On the Messaging API tab, press Issue to create one. The token is checked with LINE when you save.
connection.notVerified: The token has not been checked with LINE yet

autoReply.title: Automatic reply
autoReply.sub: Sent once when a customer writes and no Agent is online. It uses LINE's free reply, which does not count against the message quota.
autoReply.label: Message
autoReply.emptyHint: Can be empty; then nothing is sent automatically

webhook.title: Webhook URL
webhook.sub: The URL LINE calls when a customer sends a message. It does not change when you edit the settings.
webhook.label: LINE webhook URL
webhook.afterSave: The webhook URL is ready after the first save

steps.title: Setting up the LINE side
steps.credentials: In LINE Developers open the Messaging API channel of your Official Account. Copy the Channel ID and Channel secret from the Basic settings tab, and press Issue under Channel access token (long-lived) on the Messaging API tab. Paste them on this page.
steps.save: Choose a queue, turn LINE on and save. The token is checked with LINE and the webhook URL appears.
steps.webhook: Copy the webhook URL into the Webhook URL field on the Messaging API tab and press Update.
steps.verify: Turn on Use webhook and press Verify. It must report success.
steps.autoResponse: In LINE Official Account Manager open Response settings and turn off the account's own Auto-response messages and Greeting message. Otherwise customers get two answers.

quota: Agent replies are sent as push messages, which count against the Official Account's monthly message quota. The automatic reply uses LINE's reply, which does not.

state.title: Status
state.onHint: Customer messages from LINE enter the chosen queue. When turned off, chats already open continue until they end.
state.offHint: Off. Customer messages from LINE do not enter the system.
state.needQueue: Choose the queue that receives chats
state.cannotEnable: Cannot turn on yet. Finish the {{count}} item(s) above.

errors.queueRequired: Choose a queue before turning on
errors.queueInvalid: This queue cannot be used. Choose another.
errors.secretRequired: Enter the Channel secret before turning on
errors.secretInvalid: The Channel secret is 32 characters (0–9, a–f)
errors.tokenRequired: Enter the Channel access token before turning on
errors.tokenInvalid: The Channel access token is not in the right format. Check that it was copied in full.
errors.tokenRejected: LINE did not accept this token. Check that it is the long-lived Channel access token of this channel and has not been reissued.
errors.rejected: The server did not accept the values. Check them and save again.

saveFirst: Save and create the webhook URL
saveFailed: Could not save. The connection to the server was lost. Your edits are still in the form.
lineUnavailable: Could not reach LINE to check the token, so nothing was saved. Your edits are still in the form. Try saving again.
secretStoreUnavailable: The server has no secret key configured, so the secret and token cannot be saved. Tell the platform administrator.
conflict: Someone changed these settings after you opened the page. Load the latest and edit again. What you typed is still in the form.
